crossRefs.note: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to…
You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and…
Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to…
“Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,
It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite…

parallels.note: It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite…

translations.web: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
translations.bsb: But He brought us out from there to lead us in and give us the land that He had sworn to our fathers.
translations.kjv: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
translations.asv: and he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
